profiles.label: iPhone 16
profiles.validation: The compatible-graphics iPhone profile scenario and 26-step CounterLab functional smoke passed. DataMigrator success: false still blocks clean creation acceptance.
profiles.note: A fresh iPhone 16 guest on iOS 27.0.1, build 24A446, completed ordinary Setup Assistant through the UI. In compatible graphics, the 12-step iPhone profile scenario and 26-step CounterLab smoke passed. The smoke covered counter actions, semantic scrolling and taps, Details navigation, Unicode input (Hello from Linux ✓), Home, and count 1 after app terminate/relaunch. The note is transient; its persistence was not tested. DataMigrator success: false leaves clean creation unaccepted. Repeatable cold guest startup, playback, app performance, Duo, and iPad behavior remain unverified.
profiles.source: Compatible iPhone app smoke · acceptance pending
